moments.title: Tualatin River National Wildlife Refuge
moments.text: Near Sherwood the refuge keeps nearly five miles of trails and a deck over seasonal ponds, and in winter, when parts are flooded, up to 50,000 waterfowl come in.

moments.title: Gaston
moments.text: Joseph Gaston, the railroad man the town is named for, spent sixteen years trying to drain Wapato Lake for farmland, and since 2008 the refuge has been buying the lakebed back for wetland.

moments.title: Old Scotch Church
moments.text: Settlers from Aberdeenshire put up this Carpenter Gothic church in 1878 with an eight-sided steeple and stained glass from Scotland, and the pioneer Joseph Meek lies in its cemetery.
